title: WHEN A MAN LOVES A WOMAN
lyrics_synced:
[00:17.33] When a man loves a woman
[00:23.00] Can't keep his mind on nothin' else.
[00:27.00] He'd change the world
[00:29.00] For a good thing he's found.
[00:33.01] If she is bad, he can't see it;
[00:38.99] She can do no wrong.
[00:43.00] Turn his back on his best friend
[00:45.56] If he put her down.
[00:48.99] When a man loves a woman,
[00:54.99] Spend his very last a dime
[00:59.01] Tryin' to hold on to what he needs.
[01:05.01] He'll give up all his comforts,
[01:10.99] Sleep out in the rain,
[01:14.99] If she says that's the way it ought to be.
[01:23.33] Well, this man loves you woman,
[01:30.67] I give you everything I had.
[01:39.01] Try'in to hold on to your highclass love,
[01:45.97] Baby please don't treat me bad.
[01:52.99] When a man loves a woman,
[01:58.99] Deep down in his soul,
[02:02.90] She can bring him such misery.
[02:09.00] If she is playing him for a fool,
[02:15.01] He's the last one to know;
[02:18.99] Lovin eyes can never see.
[02:25.01] When a man loves a woman,
[02:30.99] He can do her no wrong,
[02:34.99] He could never want some other girl.
[02:41.00] Yes, when a man loves a woman,
[02:46.66] I know exactly how he feels;
[02:50.67] Baby, baby, baby you're my world.
[02:56.92] When a man loves a woman,
[03:02.99] Know exactly how he feels.
